rest.message: Your pace has slowed by {percent}% since the start of this session. A pause of {minutes, plural, one{# minute} other{# minutes}} is available.
rest.reason: This is a rolling median of your correct-answer times within this session — an observation about today, not a judgement about your stamina.

metacognition.message: Confidence {confidence} of 5 on a wrong answer. This is the most useful kind of error: you didn't just not know — you didn't know that you didn't know.
metacognition.reason: Confidence paired with correctness is calibration. The gap matters more than the error itself.
metacognition.action: Work through it with the tutor

contrast.message: {errors, plural, one{# error} other{# errors}} in the last {window} items on closely related topics. That looks like two concepts blurring together, not a gap.
contrast.reason: Errors are counted across this node and its graph neighbours (related and contrast links).

difficulty.message: Level {level} of 5. On items like this you can ask for a leading hint — it points, it doesn't answer.
difficulty.reason: The level comes from the Bloom taxonomy of this node's items.

capture.confusion: The confusion is sharp right now — three items from here it will be gone. One sentence in the notebook keeps it.
capture.transfer: The transfer item didn't work out. What exactly failed to carry over from the original context?
capture.reason: The note anchors itself to this node and item automatically.

review.message: Worth rereading {count, plural, one{# note} other{# notes}} before practising: "{title}".
review.reason: The knowledge under this note has come due for review.

notes.title: Notebook
notes.empty: Nothing yet. The first note usually arrives straight out of practice.
notes.conflict: This note changed elsewhere. Your text on screen is untouched.

map.conflict: The layout changed elsewhere. Reload the map.

interleaving.definition: Mixing related but distinguishable topics within one session. Performance during the session drops compared with blocked practice; delayed retention rises.

jok.definition: Judgment of Knowing — how well you feel you know something BEFORE attempting it. Different from the confidence you rate after answering.

calibration.definition: How closely your confidence matches your actual accuracy. The gap matters more than the error: it shows where you don't know that you don't know.

strength.definition: 0–100. Combines FSRS retrievability, accuracy, speed and Bloom-level coverage. It is not a score and is never compared with anyone else's.

automaticity.definition: Fast and correct answers across repetitions spread over time. The point where knowledge stops requiring conscious effort.

fsrs.definition: The review scheduling algorithm. It picks the next date so the item comes back right at the edge of forgetting.
